items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1967-10-28
items.q: The interviewee is named Arthur 'Monk' Hazel. The mention of Geraldine Prune occurs entirely within an [INTERVIEWER] turn, which appears to be a commercial advertisement for 'Custom Audio'. There is no interaction or statement from the interviewee regarding Geraldine Prune.

ctx.x: let's take another break here Monk and when we come back I'm gonna play a recording by Elvin Jones who is a young modern drummer see how you like it we'll be back in just a moment

Geraldine Prune with her used to be a quiet shy little old lady until her gramophone broke I even custom audio couldn't get parts to fix it so Bob and John installed a new component stereo system and Miss Prune with her took home some of their excellent stereo records and pre-recorded tapes and now Geraldine's a real swinger now you may not want to be a swinger but if you want the best sound system available go over to custom audio 7210 Washington Avenue the home of stereo land just off Carrollton where there's…

Hazel is our guest tonight on jazz review for those of you who may not know although if you live in New Orleans I don't see how that's possible mr. Hazel has been in jazz music 50 years this year as a drummer trombonist cornetist and also playing the mellophone mr. Hazel we're talking about Coltrane and his former drummer Elvin Jones is now on his own recording with his own groups I'd like to play you one one recording from Elvin's latest album and ask you to comment on it here it is 된된 The End
